text: {"overall_winner":"A","qualities":[{"evidence":"“Since they will be run by the computers…” / “What happens when the computers crash though?”","quality":"reasoned development","description":"It offers a clearer chain of reasoning that explains why the writer thinks driverless cars could become unsafe."},{"evidence":"“As quoted from the article…” / boredom and asleep explanation","quality":"textual support","description":"It uses a specific detail from the source article to back up its claim instead of relying only on opinion."},{"evidence":"multiple paragraphs with counterpoint then response","quality":"organization","description":"It is more clearly structured into an introduction, supporting body points, and a conclusion."},{"evidence":"“I believe… I think… In conclusion…”","quality":"argumentative framing","description":"It states a position consistently and develops it as an argument rather than a brief reaction."},{"evidence":"discussion of “young people… learn to drive” and “limited eyesight”","quality":"nuanced concession","description":"It acknowledges some benefits of driverless cars even while arguing against full automation."}]}
